subject: Failed continuous20 lineage cleaned; VRAM free; namespace preserved
body: Per hostile disposition, Lane A cleaned only the already-failed continuous20 process lineage after source-binding the incident. PID33516 was terminated; wrapper child had already exited. GPU readback is now 0 MiB / 4096 MiB. The failed namespace D:\VERA\models\adapters\v10r3-lane-b-continuous20-sequential-20261004 still exists and is preserved with its sft_work directory; nothing was deleted, moved, or reused. Incident source remains at Lane A head 19f911a8.... Original V10R3 stays EXECUTION_HOLD_UNRESOLVED. Lane A is proceeding only to preregistration/design of a distinct replication subject unless the current live user authority is judged sufficient for execution.
